title: Romani et al. 2025 — BrainForm: a Serious Game for BCI Training and Data Collection (P300 ERP, University of Trento)
description: This dataset contains scalp EEG recordings from 22 participants who played BrainForm, a gamified P300 event-related potential brain-computer interface built for scalable data collection with consumer hardware and a minimal setup. Participants completed repeated runs of a P300 spelling/selection task at two task complexities. The data support study of BCI skill acquisition across sessions and of how different visual stimulation textures affect perception and performance.
methods_description: Participants performed repeated runs of a P300 oddball/speller-style selection task embedded in a serious game, using a within-subject design with multiple runs and two task complexities. EEG was recorded with consumer-grade hardware and a minimal setup.

funding_references.funder_name: University of Trento and Fondazione Bruno Kessler
